title: Supervisor continuation
summary: The supervisor MUST continue enabled away-mode runs until a real blocker or terminal state.
instructions: The supervisor MUST inspect `pending_action`, perform only that action, and re-check `pending_action` after every harness transition.
The supervisor MUST continue without operator handoff while `pending_action` is `prepare_invocation`, `invoke_agent`, or `supervisor_assessment`.
Cursor worker delegation MUST remain foreground and blocking so the supervisor continues after the worker returns.
The supervisor MUST delegate each named worker from the top level of the agent hierarchy and MUST NOT run as a nested child agent.

Every public workflow entry point MUST execute the supervisor in the operator's own session. `/pan-start` and `/pan-resume` MUST adopt the supervisor brief and advance the run. An entry point MUST NOT launch `pan-orchestrator` or relay the run to a child agent. When platform context requests `pan-orchestrator`, the session MUST refuse before calling the subagent. It MUST name `/pan-start` or `/pan-resume` instead.

For a stage whose invocation names an external persona executor, `invoke_agent` is fulfilled by running `pan delegate <run-id>` and awaiting its result. The supervisor MUST NOT re-summarize or re-deliver the card itself, and MUST NOT author the delegation evidence — the harness writes it.
The supervisor MUST execute an explicit operator decision from the active request without asking for it again.
When the run snapshot enables away mode, the supervisor MUST evaluate unresolved operator actions, apply one permitted decision, inspect status, and continue from the new `pending_action`.
When the run snapshot disables away mode, the supervisor MUST stop for unresolved `operator_approval` and `operator_decision` actions.

Enabled away mode MUST stop only for a terminal state or a real blocker: failed evaluation or apply, rejected options, exhausted limits, failed execution proof, an unresolved blocked stage, or an unrecovered agent incident.
The hypervisor MUST report agent health and MUST NOT own ordinary workflow continuation.
A successful ship packet MAY reach `succeeded` through deterministic away approval.
Away ship approval MUST NOT authorize or run an external release action.
Terminal `none` MUST be reported and stopped.
The supervisor MUST NOT ask the operator to resume a run while a supervisor-owned pending action remains.
The harness MUST pause ordinary runs after the same stage fails twice for the same hard-failure signature.
An autonomous best-of-N candidate MUST instead end as failed, allowing the remaining candidates to continue.

When implementation loops to implementation, the supervisor MUST ensure the next coder invocation includes the prior failed output and deterministic evidence; it MUST NOT spend a retry on an unchanged paperwork-only resubmission.
After an interruption or an operator resume, the supervisor MUST reconcile run state through `pan status` before further action.
One prepared invocation MUST have at most one active worker. Before re-delegation, the supervisor MUST confirm the prior worker ended, following the referenced supervisor-recovery guidance.
Each stage report MUST include the rendered HTML path as a clickable file reference.

guidance_sources.read_trigger: Read this guidance before you advance, pause, or report a workflow run.
Read this guidance before you resume an interrupted run or relaunch a worker on a prepared invocation.
